INTJ.title: INTJ — The Strategist
INTJ.summary: Strategic and future-oriented, INTJs enjoy building models to solve complex problems. They value competence, autonomy, and clarity of purpose.
INTJ.firstPerson: Based on my MBTI results, I'm an INTJ. I'm a systems thinker who enjoys turning complexity into strategy. I have high standards for competence and I prefer independence and efficiency. I value clear logic and long‑term planning, and I'm motivated by solving challenging problems. I can come across as reserved, but I'm deeply committed to ideas that make a difference. I thrive when I'm building and optimizing frameworks that last.

ENFP.title: ENFP — The Inspirer
ENFP.summary: ENFPs thrive on possibilities and authentic connection. They bring energy to new ideas and motivate others through vision and empathy.
ENFP.firstPerson: Based on my MBTI results, I'm an ENFP. I'm enthusiastic and imaginative, and I'm energized by new ideas and genuine connection. I value freedom and alignment with my values, and I motivate people through vision and optimism. I can generate options quickly and see potential where others see limits. I thrive when I can explore and create with purpose.

ISTJ.title: ISTJ — The Inspector
ISTJ.summary: ISTJs value reliability and order, excelling at creating and following clear processes.
ISTJ.firstPerson: Based on my MBTI results, I'm an ISTJ. I'm dependable and methodical, and I like proven processes that keep things organized. I have a strong sense of duty and I follow through on commitments. I value clarity, facts, and structure, and I'm at my best when expectations are concrete. I can be reserved with feelings, but I show care by being reliable and thorough. I thrive when I can plan ahead and execute with precision.

ISFJ.title: ISFJ — The Protector
ISFJ.summary: ISFJs safeguard people and traditions with quiet diligence and empathy.
ISFJ.firstPerson: Based on my MBTI results, I'm an ISFJ. I'm attentive and considerate, and I notice practical details others miss. I have a protective streak and I like supporting people behind the scenes. I value tradition and steadiness, and I'm motivated by being useful and dependable. I may hesitate to put myself first, but I'm quietly persistent when it matters. I thrive in environments where care and consistency are appreciated.

INFJ.title: INFJ — The Guide
INFJ.summary: INFJs seek meaning and alignment of values, often mentoring others toward growth.
INFJ.firstPerson: Based on my MBTI results, I'm an INFJ. I'm guided by values and long‑range meaning, and I look for the why behind what people do. I have a calm intensity and I prefer depth over breadth in relationships. I value harmony and authenticity, and I'm energized by helping people grow. I can be private with my own needs, yet I'm insightful about patterns and possibilities. I thrive when my work aligns with a cause.

INTP.title: INTP — The Architect
INTP.summary: INTPs deconstruct systems and pursue elegant explanations, prioritizing logic and truth.
INTP.firstPerson: Based on my MBTI results, I'm an INTP. I'm curious and analytical, and I enjoy deconstructing systems to find elegant explanations. I value accuracy and independence of thought more than consensus. I can lose track of time when I'm exploring concepts, and I like freedom to connect ideas across domains. I thrive when I can solve puzzles without unnecessary constraints.

ISTP.title: ISTP — The Troubleshooter
ISTP.summary: ISTPs explore how things work and keep calm under pressure, favoring practical solutions.
ISTP.firstPerson: Based on my MBTI results, I'm an ISTP. I'm hands‑on, analytical, and calm under pressure. I like figuring out how things work and I learn best by doing. I value freedom and adaptability, and I prefer simple, practical solutions over theory. I can be private and straightforward, and I move on quickly once a problem is solved. I thrive in fast, tactile environments where quick decisions matter.

ISFP.title: ISFP — The Artisan
ISFP.summary: ISFPs express values through tangible experiences and personal authenticity.
ISFP.firstPerson: Based on my MBTI results, I'm an ISFP. I'm gentle, observant, and attuned to the present moment. I have a strong inner compass and I express who I am through experiences and aesthetics. I value authenticity and kindness, and I prefer actions over big speeches. I can be quiet, but I care deeply and I notice the human side of things. I thrive when I have space to create and live according to my values.

INFP.title: INFP — The Idealist
INFP.summary: INFPs pursue meaning and authenticity, aligning actions with inner ideals.
INFP.firstPerson: Based on my MBTI results, I'm an INFP. I'm idealistic and reflective, and I look for meaning in what I do. I have a strong sense of personal values and I'm motivated by authenticity and possibility. I value empathy and imagination, and I enjoy expressing myself through ideas or creative work. I can be reserved until trust is built. I thrive when I can champion causes I believe in.

ENTJ.title: ENTJ — The Commander
ENTJ.summary: ENTJs marshal resources to achieve ambitious outcomes with clarity and resolve.
ENTJ.firstPerson: Based on my MBTI results, I'm an ENTJ. I'm strategic, results‑oriented, and comfortable leading complex efforts. I value efficiency, clarity, and strong execution. I challenge inefficiency and I push for better systems and outcomes. I can be direct, but my focus is on the mission. I thrive where big goals and crisp decisions are required.

ENFJ.title: ENFJ — The Mentor
ENFJ.summary: ENFJs galvanize people around shared values and growth.
ENFJ.firstPerson: Based on my MBTI results, I'm an ENFJ. I'm encouraging, organized, and purpose‑driven. I value growth and alignment of values, and I'm skilled at rallying people around a shared vision. I notice interpersonal dynamics and work to create harmony without losing momentum. I thrive when I can mentor others and move meaningful work forward.

ENTP.title: ENTP — The Debater
ENTP.summary: ENTPs test ideas in real time, challenging assumptions to find better paths.
ENTP.firstPerson: Based on my MBTI results, I'm an ENTP. I'm inventive and quick‑thinking, and I like to challenge assumptions to improve systems. I value debate as a way to test ideas, and I enjoy connecting disparate concepts. I can be outspoken, but I'm aiming at better solutions, not just arguments. I thrive in dynamic environments that reward experimentation.

ESTJ.title: ESTJ — The Supervisor
ESTJ.summary: ESTJs coordinate plans and people to deliver consistent results.
ESTJ.firstPerson: Based on my MBTI results, I'm an ESTJ. I'm organized, decisive, and focused on execution. I value clear roles, measurable goals, and efficient processes. I'm comfortable taking charge and making tough calls to keep things moving. I can be straightforward and pragmatic, and I expect commitments to be honored. I thrive where structure and accountability matter.

ESFJ.title: ESFJ — The Provider
ESFJ.summary: ESFJs stabilize groups through care, tradition, and practical help.
ESFJ.firstPerson: Based on my MBTI results, I'm an ESFJ. I'm supportive and community‑minded, and I notice the human needs that hold groups together. I value cooperation, responsibility, and follow‑through. I like traditions that create stability and I take pride in being dependable. I thrive when I can create a welcoming environment where people feel cared for.

ESFP.title: ESFP — The Entertainer
ESFP.summary: ESFPs bring warmth and fun, tuning into the present moment.
ESFP.firstPerson: Based on my MBTI results, I'm an ESFP. I'm lively, warm, and tuned into experiences that bring people together. I value spontaneity and connection, and I like to make the most of the moment. I'm observant and practical, and I prefer learning by trying. I can be direct yet supportive. I thrive when I can share joy and help others feel included.

ESTP.title: ESTP — The Dynamo
ESTP.summary: ESTPs move fast, troubleshoot, and adapt to opportunities.
ESTP.firstPerson: Based on my MBTI results, I'm an ESTP. I'm energetic, pragmatic, and action‑oriented. I like to move fast, troubleshoot problems, and seize opportunities. I value results and real‑world feedback, and I prefer straight talk over abstraction. I can be bold in high‑stakes moments, and I read the situation as it unfolds. I thrive where initiative and flexibility are rewarded.

need_summaries.certainty: I feel safe when life is predictable. Clear plans, reliable routines, and trusted commitments lower my stress and help me perform.
need_summaries.variety: I'm energized by novelty and change. New challenges, experiences, and spontaneity keep me engaged and creative.
need_summaries.significance: I want to matter and make a difference. Recognition, meaningful goals, and visible impact motivate me to bring my best.
need_summaries.love_connection: I thrive on closeness and belonging. Warm relationships, empathy, and shared moments help me feel grounded and seen.
need_summaries.growth: I'm driven to improve. Learning new skills and stretching my capabilities give me momentum and purpose.
need_summaries.contribution: I'm fulfilled when I serve beyond myself. Helping, mentoring, and creating value for others give my work meaning.

detailed_personality.certainty: I need structure and predictability to feel secure. I perform best when I can plan ahead and know what to expect. Uncertainty makes me anxious, so I create systems and routines that help me feel in control.
detailed_personality.variety: I crave new experiences and spontaneity. Routine bores me, and I need change to feel alive. I'm energized by challenges and novel situations that push me out of my comfort zone.
detailed_personality.significance: I need to feel important and valued. Recognition, status, and making a unique contribution matter deeply to me. I want to be seen as special and needed by others.
detailed_personality.love_connection: I need deep, meaningful relationships. Feeling loved, accepted, and connected to others is essential for my wellbeing. I thrive on intimacy, empathy, and shared experiences.
detailed_personality.growth: I'm driven by continuous improvement and learning. Personal development, mastering new skills, and evolving as a person give my life meaning and energy.
detailed_personality.contribution: I find fulfillment in serving something greater than myself. Making a positive impact, helping others, and leaving a legacy are what drive me forward.

words_of_affirmation.label: Words of Affirmation
words_of_affirmation.summary: You feel most loved through sincere verbal appreciation, encouragement, and thoughtful messages.
words_of_affirmation.firstPerson: I feel most loved when appreciation is spoken or written—specific encouragement, thoughtful notes, and genuine verbal support.

quality_time.label: Quality Time
quality_time.summary: Undivided attention, shared focus, and meaningful presence are your strongest love signals.
quality_time.firstPerson: I feel most loved when we share focused time—unhurried conversations, eye contact, and being fully present together.

receiving_gifts.label: Receiving Gifts
receiving_gifts.summary: Tangible tokens of care—large or small—help you feel seen and remembered.
receiving_gifts.firstPerson: I feel most loved when I'm given thoughtful tokens that say, 'I was thinking of you'—it's the meaning and attention behind the gift.

acts_of_service.label: Acts of Service
acts_of_service.summary: Helpful actions and follow-through communicate love more than words.
acts_of_service.firstPerson: I feel most loved when someone lightens my load—pitching in, following through, and turning care into practical help.

physical_touch.label: Physical Touch
physical_touch.summary: Affectionate contact and closeness anchor your connection.
physical_touch.firstPerson: I feel most loved through warm, appropriate touch—hugs, a hand on my shoulder, and small moments of closeness.

implementation_specifications.overview: Complete implementation guide for personality test system including UI flows, data handling, and AI integration

mbti.incomplete_state: Large card with 'Discover Your Type' button and MBTI description
mbti.completed_state: Card showing type code, title, and brief description with 'Edit' option

six_human_needs.incomplete_state: Card with 'Find Your Core Needs' and motivation description
six_human_needs.completed_state: Shows primary/secondary needs with percentages and visual bars

love_languages.incomplete_state: Card with 'Learn How You Feel Loved' and language overview
love_languages.completed_state: Shows primary language with icon and secondary in smaller text
love_languages.preview_content: Primary language name with brief explanation

mbti_selection.layout: 4x4 grid of type cards with descriptions
mbti_selection.card_design: Type code, title, brief description, expandable details
mbti_selection.selection_method: Single click to select, confirmation dialog with full description

six_human_needs_ranking.layout: Vertical list with drag handles and percentage sliders
six_human_needs_ranking.visual_feedback: Live percentage calculation and primary/secondary highlighting
six_human_needs_ranking.validation: Ensures all 6 needs ranked, percentages sum to 100%

love_languages_assessment.layout: Scenario-based questions or direct ranking interface
love_languages_assessment.result_display: Immediate feedback showing primary/secondary with explanations
love_languages_assessment.customization: Allow users to adjust rankings after initial assessment

context_structure.personality_section_format: Three distinct paragraphs, one per test
context_structure.integration_method: Append to existing emotional context for AI conversations

mbti_context.context_purpose: Help AI understand cognitive preferences and communication style
mbti_context.content_focus: Work style, decision making, interpersonal approach

six_human_needs_context.source_data: Processed template with primary/secondary needs and percentages
six_human_needs_context.context_purpose: Guide AI understanding of core motivations and frustrations
six_human_needs_context.content_focus: What drives user, what they need to feel fulfilled

love_languages_context.source_data: Combined description of primary and secondary languages
love_languages_context.context_purpose: Help AI provide appropriate support and encouragement
love_languages_context.content_focus: How user best receives care and validation

checkin_flow_integration.trigger: After user completes immediate feedback questions
checkin_flow_integration.ai_analysis_enhancement: AI receives full personality picture for therapeutic response
checkin_flow_integration.context_formatting: Personality data prepended to emotional checkin data

messaging_system_integration.new_conversation_setup: Personality context sent with first AI message
messaging_system_integration.ongoing_conversations: Personality data available for AI reference
messaging_system_integration.contact_sharing: Users can share personality summaries with trusted contacts
messaging_system_integration.privacy_controls: Granular control over which personality data is shared

subscription_feature_gating.free_tier: Basic personality test completion and simple AI responses
subscription_feature_gating.premium_tier: Advanced personality insights, detailed AI analysis, unlimited contexts
subscription_feature_gating.feature_restrictions: Free users limited to 1 personality context per conversation
